nba_scope.sql: SELECT prefix, count(*) games, min(played_at) first_game, max(played_at) last_game, min(season_start) first_season, max(season_start) last_season FROM nba_games GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 1

excluded_game_categories.sql: SELECT prefix, CASE WHEN season_start<1949 THEN 'pre-NBA boundary' ELSE 'outside regular/playoff analytics' END reason,count(*) games FROM g WHERE NOT(season_start>=1949 AND prefix IN ('002','004')) GROUP BY 1,2 ORDER BY 1,2

game_type_by_prefix.sql: SELECT prefix, gameType, count(*) games FROM g GROUP BY 1,2 ORDER BY 1,2

season_date_disagreements.sql: SELECT gameId,gameDateTimeEst,season_start FROM g WHERE year(played_at) NOT BETWEEN season_start AND season_start+1 LIMIT 30

game_score_integrity.sql: SELECT count(*) FILTER(WHERE hs<=0 OR aws<=0) nonpositive_score_games, count(*) FILTER(WHERE hs=aws) tied_games, count(*) FILTER(WHERE hometeamId=awayteamId) same_team_games, count(*) FILTER(WHERE winner IS DISTINCT FROM CASE WHEN hs>aws THEN hometeamId WHEN aws>hs THEN awayteamId END) wrong_winner FROM nba_games

player_orphans.sql: SELECT count(*) FILTER(WHERE g.gameId IS NULL) rows_without_game, count(*) FILTER(WHERE pl.personId IS NULL) rows_without_player_bio, count(*) FILTER(WHERE p.personId IS NULL) null_player_ids FROM player_stats p LEFT JOIN games g USING(gameId) LEFT JOIN players pl USING(personId)

orphan_player_examples.sql: SELECT p.personId,p.firstName,p.lastName,count(*) AS row_count FROM player_stats p LEFT JOIN players pl USING(personId) WHERE pl.personId IS NULL GROUP BY 1,2,3 ORDER BY 4 DESC LIMIT 15

orphan_games_in_team_stats.sql: SELECT t.gameId,t.teamId,t.gameDateTimeEst FROM team_stats t LEFT JOIN games g USING(gameId) WHERE g.gameId IS NULL

player_game_metadata.sql: SELECT count(*) missing_source_team_ids, count(*) FILTER(WHERE inferred_team_id IS NOT NULL) recoverable_from_game_and_home FROM np WHERE playerteamId IS NULL

player_game_metadata_conflicts.sql: SELECT count(*) FILTER(WHERE playerteamId IS NOT NULL AND playerteamId IS DISTINCT FROM inferred_team_id) team_conflicts, count(*) FILTER(WHERE opponentteamId IS NOT NULL AND opponentteamId IS DISTINCT FROM CASE WHEN home='1' THEN awayteamId WHEN home='0' THEN hometeamId END) opponent_conflicts, count(*) FILTER(WHERE try_cast(gameDateTimeEst AS TIMESTAMP) IS DISTINCT FROM played_at) date_conflicts_or_missing FROM np

participation_patterns.sql: SELECT CASE WHEN n_numMinutes>0 THEN 'positive minutes' WHEN n_numMinutes=0 THEN 'zero minutes' ELSE 'missing minutes' END minutes_status, comment IS NOT NULL has_comment, count(*) AS row_count, count(*) FILTER(WHERE n_points>0) rows_with_points FROM np GROUP BY 1,2 ORDER BY 1,2

participation_comments.sql: SELECT comment,count(*) AS row_count FROM np WHERE comment IS NOT NULL GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 2 DESC LIMIT 25

zero_minutes_with_stats.sql: SELECT personId,firstName,lastName,gameId,gameDateTimeEst,numMinutes,points,assists,reboundsTotal,comment FROM np WHERE n_numMinutes=0 AND (n_points>0 OR n_assists>0 OR n_reboundsTotal>0) LIMIT 30

played_with_dnp_comment.sql: SELECT personId,gameId,numMinutes,comment FROM np WHERE n_numMinutes>0 AND (comment ILIKE '%DNP%' OR comment ILIKE '%DND%' OR comment ILIKE '%inactive%') LIMIT 30

numeric_parse_failures.sql: SELECT count(*) FILTER(WHERE numMinutes IS NOT NULL AND n_numMinutes IS NULL) AS numMinutes,count(*) FILTER(WHERE points IS NOT NULL AND n_points IS NULL) AS points,count(*) FILTER(WHERE assists IS NOT NULL AND n_assists IS NULL) AS assists,count(*) FILTER(WHERE reboundsTotal IS NOT NULL AND n_reboundsTotal IS NULL) AS reboundsTotal,count(*) FILTER(WHERE reboundsOffensive IS NOT NULL AND n_reboundsOffensive IS NULL) AS reboundsOffensive,count(*) FILTER(WHERE reboundsDefensive IS NOT NULL AND n_reboundsDefensive IS NULL) AS reboundsDefensive,count(*) FILTER(WHERE steals IS NOT NULL AND n_steals IS NULL) AS steals,count(*) FILTER(WHERE blocks IS NOT NULL AND n_blocks IS NULL) AS blocks,count(*) FILTER(WHERE turnovers IS NOT NULL AND n_turnovers IS NULL) AS turnovers,count(*) FILTER(WHERE fieldGoalsMade IS NOT NULL AND n_fieldGoalsMade IS NULL) AS fieldGoalsMade,count(*) FILTER(WHERE fieldGoalsAttempted IS NOT NULL AND n_fieldGoalsAttempted IS NULL) AS fieldGoalsAttempted,count(*) FILTER(WHERE threePointersMade IS NOT NULL AND n_threePointersMade IS NULL) AS threePointersMade,count(*) FILTER(WHERE threePointersAttempted IS NOT NULL AND n_threePointersAttempted IS NULL) AS threePointersAttempted,count(*) FILTER(WHERE freeThrowsMade IS NOT NULL AND n_freeThrowsMade IS NULL) AS freeThrowsMade,count(*) FILTER(WHERE freeThrowsAttempted IS NOT NULL AND n_freeThrowsAttempted IS NULL) AS freeThrowsAttempted,count(*) FILTER(WHERE foulsPersonal IS NOT NULL AND n_foulsPersonal IS NULL) AS foulsPersonal,count(*) FILTER(WHERE plusMinusPoints IS NOT NULL AND n_plusMinusPoints IS NULL) AS plusMinusPoints FROM np

box_score_identities.sql: SELECT count(*) FILTER(WHERE n_points IS NOT NULL AND n_fieldGoalsMade IS NOT NULL AND n_freeThrowsMade IS NOT NULL AND n_points<>2*n_fieldGoalsMade+coalesce(n_threePointersMade,0)+n_freeThrowsMade) points_formula_conflicts, count(*) FILTER(WHERE n_fieldGoalsMade>n_fieldGoalsAttempted OR n_threePointersMade>n_threePointersAttempted OR n_freeThrowsMade>n_freeThrowsAttempted) makes_exceed_attempts, count(*) FILTER(WHERE n_threePointersMade>n_fieldGoalsMade OR n_threePointersAttempted>n_fieldGoalsAttempted) threes_exceed_field_goals, count(*) FILTER(WHERE n_reboundsTotal<>n_reboundsOffensive+n_reboundsDefensive) rebound_sum_conflicts, count(*) FILTER(WHERE n_points<0 OR n_assists<0 OR n_reboundsTotal<0 OR n_numMinutes<0) negative_count_or_minutes FROM np

season_coverage.sql: WITH pc AS (SELECT gameId,count(*) player_rows,count(*) FILTER(WHERE try_cast(numMinutes AS DOUBLE)>0) positive_minutes_rows FROM player_stats GROUP BY 1), tc AS (SELECT gameId,count(*) team_rows FROM team_stats GROUP BY 1) SELECT g.season_start,g.prefix,count(*) games,count(*) FILTER(WHERE pc.gameId IS NULL) games_without_player_rows,count(*) FILTER(WHERE tc.gameId IS NULL) games_without_team_rows,count(*) FILTER(WHERE tc.team_rows<>2) games_with_wrong_team_row_count,sum(coalesce(pc.player_rows,0)) player_rows,min(played_at) first_game,max(played_at) last_game FROM nba_games g LEFT JOIN pc USING(gameId) LEFT JOIN tc USING(gameId) GROUP BY 1,2 ORDER BY 1,2

metric_completeness_by_season.sql: SELECT season_start,prefix,count(*) AS row_count,count(*) FILTER(WHERE n_numMinutes IS NULL) missing_numMinutes,count(*) FILTER(WHERE n_points IS NULL) missing_points,count(*) FILTER(WHERE n_assists IS NULL) missing_assists,count(*) FILTER(WHERE n_reboundsTotal IS NULL) missing_reboundsTotal,count(*) FILTER(WHERE n_steals IS NULL) missing_steals,count(*) FILTER(WHERE n_blocks IS NULL) missing_blocks,count(*) FILTER(WHERE n_turnovers IS NULL) missing_turnovers,count(*) FILTER(WHERE n_fieldGoalsMade IS NULL) missing_fieldGoalsMade,count(*) FILTER(WHERE n_fieldGoalsAttempted IS NULL) missing_fieldGoalsAttempted,count(*) FILTER(WHERE n_threePointersMade IS NULL) missing_threePointersMade,count(*) FILTER(WHERE n_threePointersAttempted IS NULL) missing_threePointersAttempted FROM np GROUP BY 1,2 ORDER BY 1,2

team_game_score_conflicts.sql: SELECT count(*) AS row_count, count(*) FILTER(WHERE t.teamId NOT IN(g.hometeamId,g.awayteamId)) unexpected_team, count(*) FILTER(WHERE try_cast(t.teamScore AS INT) IS DISTINCT FROM CASE WHEN t.teamId=g.hometeamId THEN g.hs ELSE g.aws END) score_conflicts FROM team_stats t JOIN nba_games g USING(gameId)

player_to_team_points.sql: SELECT count(*) team_games,count(*) FILTER(WHERE row_count IS NULL) no_player_rows,count(*) FILTER(WHERE missing_points>0) incomplete_points,count(*) FILTER(WHERE missing_points=0 AND player_points<>score) non_null_player_points_score_conflicts FROM point_reconciliation

player_to_team_points_by_era.sql: SELECT (season_start//10)*10 AS decade_start,count(*) team_games,count(*) FILTER(WHERE missing_points=0 AND player_points<>score) score_conflicts,count(*) FILTER(WHERE missing_points>0) incomplete_points FROM point_reconciliation GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 1

kawhi_lebron_totals.sql: SELECT prefix,count(*) games,sum(n_points) points,sum(n_reboundsTotal) rebounds,sum(n_assists) assists,avg(n_points) ppg,avg(n_reboundsTotal) rpg,avg(n_assists) apg,sum(n_numMinutes) source_minutes,avg(n_numMinutes) source_mpg,sum(n_fieldGoalsMade)/nullif(sum(n_fieldGoalsAttempted),0) fg_pct,sum(n_threePointersMade)/nullif(sum(n_threePointersAttempted),0) three_pct,sum(n_freeThrowsMade)/nullif(sum(n_freeThrowsAttempted),0) ft_pct FROM kawhi_lebron GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 1

team_history_overlaps.sql: SELECT a.teamId,a.teamCity,a.teamName,a.league,a.seasonFounded,a.seasonActiveTill,b.teamCity other_city,b.teamName other_name,b.seasonFounded other_start,b.seasonActiveTill other_end FROM team_histories a JOIN team_histories b ON a.teamId=b.teamId AND a.seasonFounded<b.seasonFounded AND try_cast(a.seasonActiveTill AS INT)>=try_cast(b.seasonFounded AS INT) WHERE a.league='NBA' AND b.league='NBA'
